summary: Build practical PostgreSQL DBA skills in security, tuning, backup, recovery, replication, and monitoring. Explore the 10-day course.
lede: PostgreSQL database administration covers configuring, securing, monitoring, tuning, backing up, and recovering database environments. For database administrators, database engineers, and platform engineers with relational database experience, the training develops practical skills in access control, query-plan analysis with EXPLAIN, and backup validation and point-in-time recovery, alongside maintenance, capacity planning, replication, and incident response.
audienceIntro: PostgreSQL Database Administration Training is designed for professionals who already work with relational databases and need stronger operational control over PostgreSQL environments. It suits technical specialists responsible for production reliability, database security, performance, backup, or platform operations.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of relational database concepts, SQL queries, tables, indexes, transactions, and basic Linux or Unix command-line operations is expected. Familiarity with application connectivity and production change processes will help. No programming experience beyond basic SQL and shell commands is required. The course teaches advanced topics such as Patroni, logical replication, and AI-assisted query analysis at operational application or conceptual awareness level rather than production engineering depth.
